about: What /llms.txt says to agents and other programs, written at each build by site/llms.js. {name}, {url}, {source} are filled from config; the record types and the docs are added from the lexicons and docs/.
intro: {name} ({url}) lets an organization describe itself and post its jobs on atproto (the Bluesky protocol), from its own account, its domain as its handle; shows its page; and shows its jobs on its own website. It keeps nothing of its own: no server, no list, no accounts. Open source (GPL-3.0), no ads, no tracking.
lead: There is no index to read: what organizations publish is in their own atproto accounts (the records below). A job links to where to apply: applications go straight to the organization.

pages.title: An organization
pages.about: `/{domain}`, e.g. `/joblist.today`: its description and its open jobs, read from its own account

pages.title: A job
pages.about: `/job/{did}/{rkey}`: one offer, and where to apply

pages.title: Embed
pages.about: an organization's open jobs on any website: `<joblist-jobs organization="acme.org">`, or the frame `/embed/?organization=acme.org`

etiquette: joblist's requests come from each person's browser, to the organization's own account; it never crawls.
Link to an organization's page here, or to a job's page; joblist has no applications to pass on.
An organization that wants a fix: edit its page on joblist with its own account (its handle is its domain), or open an issue at {source}/issues.
